offering_description.value: Provides contract sterilization and laboratory testing for medical device, pharmaceutical and other healthcare product makers. Sterilizes customers' products at its own facilities using radiation or ethylene oxide, and tests product sterility and safety in its labs. Also supplies radiation sources and medical isotopes.

primary_services.value: contract sterilization; microbiology and sterility testing; bioburden testing; materials and package testing

customer_segment.value: B2B: medical device makers, pharmaceutical and biologics companies, other healthcare product manufacturers

end_markets.value: medical devices; pharmaceuticals; biologics; food safety; consumer products

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for sterilization and testing services, charged per processing volume or project; product sales: radiation sources and medical isotopes sold to industrial and healthcare customers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in customers' products and sterilizes or tests them for a fee, sold to healthcare product makers; asset operator: owns and runs irradiation and sterilization facilities and testing laboratories

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other regions, with facilities in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: contract sterilization, lab testing, and radiation source and isotope supply

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling sterilization and testing to medical device and pharma manufacturers; own locations: its sterilization facilities and testing laboratories serving customers directly

regulatory_exposure.value: high: ethylene oxide emissions permits from EPA and state agencies, NRC licensing for cobalt-60 sources, FDA-regulated customer products
